gatewayMiddleware.title: Gateway middleware
gatewayMiddleware.description: Transforms applied in order to every external agent's requests and replies, whatever protocol it speaks. A middleware that fails or runs too long leaves the request unchanged.
gatewayMiddleware.empty: No middleware: requests and replies pass unchanged.
gatewayMiddleware.mappingHint: asked = served. The client keeps seeing the name it asked for; the key must be allowed to use the served model.
gatewayMiddleware.agentsPlaceholder: All agents, or e.g. codex, claude-code
gatewayMiddleware.scriptHint: A .js file in the runtime's gateway-middleware folder exporting onModel, onSystemPrompt or onText. Each call is limited to 250 ms (50 ms per text delta).
gatewayMiddleware.boundaries: Middleware runs inside the Kun runtime on this computer. Scripts are your own code and are not sandboxed; only add scripts you trust.
